{{Top|leg}}
A '''pop-dog''' was a type of [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Pop-dogs are known to emerge from their burrows, dart toward their prey or any unguarded food, seize it in a flash, and swiftly retreat back to their burrows.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
